hero_title: Get back to moving the way you want to.
hero_sub: One-on-one physical therapy for back and neck pain, sports injuries and recovery after surgery. Every visit is with a licensed physical therapist.
services_intro: If you are not sure whether we can help, call and ask. We will tell you honestly.

services.name: Back and neck pain
services.text: Hands-on care and exercise for pain that keeps coming back.

services.name: Sports injuries
services.text: Sprains, strains and overuse injuries, with a plan to return to play.

services.name: After surgery
services.text: Rehab after knee, hip and shoulder surgery.

services.name: Balance and falls
services.text: Strength and balance work to help you feel steady again.

services.name: Work injuries
services.text: Care and paperwork for injuries that happened on the job.

about: Riverbend is a small clinic with two physical therapists. You see the same therapist at every visit.
Visits are one-on-one, so the whole hour is about you.
